display_name: MoPC 作者仓库版 clean 对照 MIX01–MIX03
description: 三池、MIX01–MIX03、七接收机、三模型种子；K5/10 × N5/10；clean support 和 clean query。
authorization: 用户要求指定对话中的作者仓库行为版重跑；2026-11-18 明确允许对比方法使用源域训练缓存并要求报告。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI conda Python; FP32, TF32 off

data.support_query_ref: K5/10 × N5/10; per-split physical ID separation

permissions.regime: Phase2 paired clean support/query; comparison source cache authorized
permissions.query_use: fixed per-record prediction; independent truth-last scorer
permissions.external_method_exception: MRIOR and Two-stage use L_s source replay during B; Tweak source feature enrollment is checkpoint-contained
permissions.claim_scope: author-repository behavior adapted to IQ/backbone, not unmodified author script

checkpoint.initialization: frozen Phase2 source checkpoint per method and model seed
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: checkpoint contract and no-target provenance enforced on load
checkpoint.selection_rule: previously fixed source checkpoint; no target selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPUs 0–7; explicit sharing allowed; conservatively count all observed GPU processes against cap 4; >=6000 MiB free, 3000 MiB reservation per process; do not stop other owners
execution.stop_rule: Nonfinite or author sampling missing-class tasks retained and quarantined; systemic technical failure drains; low accuracy does not stop.
